assets.prompt: Create a NEW original landscape event illustration, 1536x1024 PNG, for STARLIT GUILD stage 1-6. Input image is CHARACTER DESIGN AND PAINTING STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not the scene to edit. Preserve the two youthful adult adventurers' identities, faces, hair, eyes and outfits: Aria is blonde green-eyed pointed-eared elf, green gold-trim hood and cape, feather, white tunic, brown gloves; Leon is tousled brown-haired brown-eyed human, red scarf, blue tunic, silver shoulder armor, brown gloves. NEW SCENE: early afternoon in a nearby quiet damp forest, with ferns and tree roots. The two crouch side by side at a flat stone, comfortably familiar childhood friends focused on their small discovery. TWO separate shallow wooden dishes sit together on the stone, each with a SMALL pinch of ordinary dull dark-green featherlike moss with paired tiny branching tips. Both moss samples look very similar, clearly NOT glowing. Aria points near the paired leaf tips with a small wooden spatula without crushing them; Leon has just drawn his dish next to hers and attentively looks down at it. Close medium framing, show expressive faces, their hands and BOTH separate dishes clearly legible on a phone. Soft natural dappled daylight, no magical light. Match reference anime painted detail and warm natural expressions. Not a romance pose. No other people, tower, stone building, torch, lantern, text, label, UI, hearts, captions, borders, split panels or watermark. Do not reproduce the old tower scene or glowing moss. Natural hands, no duplicate limbs.
